AUDIO TRANSCRIPT
ERA IV
Shelter Coordinator
Welcome briefing, Day Two. We have food for approximately three weeks at current population. Water is stable. Air filtration is stable. Medical inventory is stable.
Dormant Evercrop emergency culture is available if commercial deliveries stop. Please stop asking whether that is safe. We have no evidence of contamination in the shelter stock.
The military says the exclusion order may be lifted within ten days. Stay calm. Keep your assigned sleeping area clean. Report respiratory symptoms. Do not open exterior service doors.
This is temporary. We have planned for situations like this.

AUDIO TRANSCRIPT
ERA V
Dr. Mara Vey
Emergency transmission to Shelter Network. Do not activate stored EP-7 cultures. Repeat: do not activate dormant Evercrop emergency cultures unless starvation is immediately life-threatening.
I know exactly what I am asking. Those cultures were stored because they survive almost anything. That is why they are dangerous now. If your shelter remains clean, preserve it.
If your shelter is already contaminated... I don't know. God, I hate saying that. Use your judgment. People need food. People also need somewhere left that isn't colonized.
There are no universal instructions anymore. Only tradeoffs. I'm sorry.
